name: fungal
description: Fungal INA, Mortierellaceae lineage I: N-terminal region profile INAf_N (signal peptide to first repeat, 10 sequences, 4 species) and Cys-rich C-terminal cap profile INAf_Ccap (last 45 aa, 14 sequences, 4 species); the bacterial cap profile INA_C60 is accepted only when it reaches the protein end. Lineage II INA-like proteins have no conserved terminal domains and are not modelled.

notes.INA_C60_rule: Accepted as the C-terminal cap only with hmm_to >= 50, i-Evalue <= 1e-15 and within the last 20 aa. INA_C60 also matches fungal lineage-I repeat units (real HMMER on 7 Mortierellaceae genomes: 35 non-terminal hits with hmm_from <= 15 and hmm_to >= 50, best i-Evalue 5.2e-9); the only known fungal bacterial-type cap (locus0026, M. claussenii) scores 2.1e-26.
notes.met_fallback: orf_start: when no Met lies near the first domain hit, the whole ORF is kept and start_source = ORF_start_no_Met. Fungal assemblies are fragmented and fungal genes can contain introns, so the first Met far downstream is usually not the real start.
